title: When Does Optical Context Compression Pay Off? A Decode-Aware Cost Analysis of Reasoning VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.30130v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rendering long text as images lets a vision-language model (VLM) read a document with fewer input tokens, and evaluations often count mainly these prefill tokens. We show that for reasoning models this accounting is incomplete. Across five models and two long-context benchmarks, reading the rendered document makes the model think longer: decode length grows by 1.5-3.5x on the four general-purpose VLMs tested, and under typical output pricing this decode tax makes image input more expensive than text for two of the five models on QuALITY. Unrecoverable information loss is not sufficient to explain the tax at moderate compression: Qwen's OCR of the same images recovers 98.7% of words, and feeding Kimi-K3 its own transcription as text restores text-mode reasoning length and accuracy. translated_title: 光学上下文压缩何时划算？面向推理型视觉语言模型的解码感知成本分析
translated_abstract: 将长文本渲染为图像可以让视觉语言模型（VLM）以更少的输入token读取文档，而现有评估通常主要计入这些预填充token。我们表明，对于推理模型而言，这种核算方式是不完整的。在五个模型和两个长上下文基准上的实验显示，读取渲染后的文档会使模型“思考”得更久：在测试的四个通用VLM上，解码长度增长1.5-3.5倍，并且在典型的输出定价下，这种“解码税”使得在QuALITY基准上五个模型中有两个的图像输入成本反而高于文本输入。在中等压缩率下，不可恢复的信息损失并不足以解释这一解码税：Qwen对相同图像的OCR识别恢复了98.7%的词，而将Kimi-K3自己生成的转录文本作为文本输入时，其推理长度和准确性会恢复到文本模式水平。压缩是否划算最终可归结为一个“汇率”——(1-1/c)/(r-1)，该比值必须超过该工作负载中输出与输入token的价格加权比率；这一分析
tldr: 该研究揭示推理型视觉语言模型将长文本渲染为图像虽节省输入token，但会使解码长度增长1.5-3.5倍并可能反而推高总成本，并提出判断光学压缩是否划算的汇率公式 (1-1/c)/(r-1)，即该比值需超过工作负载的输出/输入token价格加权比。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that for reasoning VLMs, rendering long text as images saves prefill tokens but inflates decode length by 1.5-3.5x, and proposes that whether optical context compression pays off reduces to an exchange rate, (1-1/c)/(r-1), which must exceed the workload's price-weighted output-to-input token ratio.
